titel: It's Your Time to Heal: God's Steps with Pastor Derwin Gray

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Pastor Derwin Gray shares how faith, neuroscience and four steps can heal past trauma.
kurzfassung: Pastor Derwin Gray discusses his new book on overcoming trauma through faith and neuroscience. He shares his personal journey of forgiving his father and healing from a difficult childhood. The conversation highlights practical steps for emotional freedom and physical well-being.
stichpunkte: Derwin Gray is a former NFL player and the founding pastor of Transformation Church.
Trauma and lack of forgiveness can lead to physical issues like high blood pressure and heart disease.
True healing begins with an identity shift toward seeing oneself as a beloved child of God.
The HEAL framework stands for being honest, expecting hard work, accepting the past, and living from love.
Forgiveness does not automatically mean reconciliation or granting access to unsafe individuals.
Unresolved anger damages mental health, while forgiveness can literally save a person's life.
Gray shares his personal breakthrough of confronting and forgiving his father, who struggled with substance abuse.

kapitel.titel: Boundaries and the True Meaning of Forgiveness

clips.hook: Forgiveness is for your own survival
clips.text: Holding onto grudges harms physical health significantly, whereas letting go of resentment protects the body from chronic conditions.

clips.hook: The danger of using vengeance as fuel
clips.text: Using anger and spite as motivation for achievements ultimately results in severe emotional and physical exhaustion.
Granting forgiveness serves as a shield against adopting the toxic traits of an abuser while protecting personal well-being.

beschreibung: What if the Gospel is the answer to America's deepest divisions and to our deepest wounds? In this episode, we sit down with Pastor Derwin Gray; former NFL player turned church planter, best-selling author, and founder of Transformation Church — for a raw, hope-filled conversation about faith, identity, healing, and what it really means to follow Jesus in a fractured world. Derwin shares his journey from the football field to the pulpit, why he believes churches aren't optional but essential, and how genuine faith moves beyond Sunday mornings into everyday transformation. We also touch on insights from Dr. Daniel Amen and Tana Amen on the connection between brain health, emotional healing, and spiritual wholeness and exploring how faith and science can work together toward a fully healed life. If you've ever wondered whether faith can survive contact with real life — and actually heal what's broken — this episode is for you. Derwin's new book: https://www.amazon.com/Its-Time-Heal-God-Given-Shattered/dp/B0GQPF3GW8
